skills.delivery_notes: Projectile thrown to landing point, explodes into large poison gas cloud on contact. Dossier: 'projectile leaving a trail of poison gas behind it... throw to one side of the creature pack.'
Thrown projectile leaving poison trail; dossier: 'Poison Javelin is used to attack monsters on the other side.' Overlapping gas clouds stack DoT.

mapping_json.motion_frame: Throw Plague Javelin cloud to one side of pack; Poison Javelin to other side; overlapping gas zones stack poison DoT; patient kill-confirmation.
mapping_json.fidelity_notes: Earth element (amazon, venom/nature-themed per main-law element table; not corruption-themed → earth not shadow). Poison ailment attested: dossier 'poison gas cloud,' 'Plague Javelin adds poison damage,' verify_ledger CONFIRMED 'poison DoT delivery.' DoT-timing ruling: 'poison DoT' attests delivery timing, not a second ailment. LF/PJ hybrid is a separate variant — pure poison-javazon is the identity mapped here.
